vectors.description: One integer in the payload changed after signing (decode p50 18400 -> 28400).
DER-encoded signature where 64-octet raw r||s is required.
Valid signature by a different key (key 2) presented to a subscriber that pinned key 1.
Payload validly signed but NOT in canonical (JCS) form (pretty-printed). Rejected to exclude parser-differential ambiguity.
Validly signed payload containing a duplicate member name (audience).
Validly signed payload containing a non-integer number.
nowMs == expiresAtMs: expired.
issuedAtMs more than 5 minutes in the future of the verifier clock.
Challenge differs from the one this requester sent (replayed presentation).
Requester expected a challenge but the presentation carries none (an unsolicited copy offered as a fresh answer).
Rollback store holds seq 18: seq 17 is a rollback.
Rollback store holds seq 17 with a DIFFERENT body digest: the signer issued two bodies under one seq.
Envelope claims another asom payload type (key-rollover). PAE binds the type, and the verifier refuses non-manifest types before verifying.
A different payload type correctly signed by the pinned key cannot be replayed as a manifest (cross-type confusion).
Payload names another node as its subject but is signed by key 1.
Challenge-bound presentation with a TTL over 10 minutes.
Envelope with two signature entries (asom profile requires exactly one).
Unknown major version in the payload type.
Unknown major version inside the signed payload.
Internally inconsistent claim: steady-state throughput above every point of its own curve.
Internally inconsistent claim: time to first token shorter than the prompt-processing time implied by its own prefill rate.
TOFU subscriber already stored a different key under this keyid; the file now presents key 2 with the same keyid hint.
Trailing data after the container JSON.
requiredTier A2 but no platform evidence: tier A1 is insufficient.
Signature base64 whose final character carries non-zero unused bits (non-canonical base64); rejected before any signature check.
Bidi override character (U+202E) in a display string: schema rejects it so plain text cannot be visually spoofed.
TOFU subscriber with no stored key and no signer.spki in the container.
Validly signed payload nested deeper than 16 levels (checked by the strict parser before schema validation).
